integrity: Exact 49-support-state proof and independently simulated finite verification supplied; finite tests do not independently certify the infinite proof. No external mathematical audit was performed.
limitations: Applies to standard three-state firefly inhibition on complete bipartite labelled graphs with a,b at least two; no claim about stars, other color numbers, incomplete bipartite graphs, stochastic clocks, or unlabeled quotient counts. Literature comparisons are bounded by accessible sources and may miss an unindexed equivalent.
title: Synchronization layers and isolated four-cycles in three-color firefly dynamics on complete bipartite graphs
